question: Where can I get a list of battery storage (BESS) installations in operation in Germany, with location, power (MW), energy (MWh), operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: The Bundesnetzagentur's Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) is the official unit-level register of reported grid-connected battery units in Germany: status, gross/net kW, usable kWh, PLZ/Gemeinde (coordinates only above 30 kW), operator and commissioning date. Query it without login through the public viewer's JSON service or the daily XML export. On 2026-11-26, 2,929,627 battery units were In Betrieb, 556 of them above 1 MW (4.75 GW, 8.37 GWh). Rows are units: group sites by LokationMastrNr. Natural-person operators are masked.
main_caveats: MaStR rows are units (SEE), not installations: one site can be many units (SWM Uppenborn: 10 × 2,610 kW). Group by LokationMastrNr (SEL) and sum storage rows only.
Over 99.8% of the 2.93 million operating battery units are connected at Niederspannung; there is no official grid-scale flag, so state the size or voltage filter used.
Coordinates are withheld for units ≤30 kW and for a few large anonymised units (e.g. RWE Werne, LEAG Big Battery Lausitz), which show only PLZ and place.
Natural-person operators are masked; data are self-declared and registered up to a month (sometimes more) after commissioning, so the latest weeks are incomplete.
The viewer's CSV export stops at 25,000 rows; use the JSON paging or the daily XML export.
answer.confidence_reason: All counts and field meanings come from live MaStR queries, the official export documentation and the MaStRV text opened on 2026-11-26; only the non-official sources stayed untested.

attributes.note: Every unit has PLZ/Ort/Gemeinde; WGS84 coordinates only for units >30 kW (§15 MaStRV): 6,646 operating units, 550 of 556 >1 MW.
Bruttoleistung and Nettonennleistung in kW, discharge (Ausspeicher) side; no charging-power field for batteries. Kraftwerksliste in MW.
NutzbareSpeicherkapazitaet in kWh on the linked storage object (SSE); empty for 57 operating units, filled for all 556 >1 MW.
Operator name and ABR number for organisations; 'natürliche Person (ABR…)' for 2,851,374 operating units, incl. 19 of 556 >1 MW.
attributes.gap_note: §15 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 MaStRV: data of natural-person operators are not published; only the masked ABR number is visible.

attributes.note: Inbetriebnahmedatum (first technical commissioning) for all operating units; registration date and date at current site are separate fields.

inclusion_rule.quote: Die Pflicht zur Registrierung nach den Absätzen 1, 3 und 4 Satz 1 entfällt 1. bei Stromerzeugungseinheiten, Stromspeichern sowie EEG- und KWK-Anlagen, wenn sie weder unmittelbar noch mittelbar an ein Stromnetz angeschlossen sind oder an ein Stromnetz angeschlossen werden sollen

reference_date.value: Viewer and JSON show the register state of the previous midnight (Datenstand 26.11.2026 00:00 Uhr on the test day); each unit carries DatumLetzteAktualisierung.

update_frequency.value: Daily; operators must report new units and changes within one month, so the most recent month is incomplete.

key_fields.meaning: Unit number of the storage unit (SEE…); one SEE per inverter/battery system as registered by the operator.
2496 = Speicher; storage technology 524 = Batterie (others: Pumpspeicher 1537, Druckluft 525, Schwungrad 526, Wasserstoffspeicher 3067).
35 In Betrieb, 31 In Planung, 37 Vorübergehend stillgelegt, 38 Endgültig stillgelegt.
Gross and net rated power in kW (discharge/generation side). No charging-power field exists for batteries.
Usable storage capacity in kWh, taken from the linked storage object (SSE).
Date of first technical commissioning of the unit vs date it was entered in the register (JSON dates as /Date(ms)/).
Commissioning date at the current site after a relocation; the first commissioning date is kept.
WGS84 coordinates; published only for units above 30 kW and not for units with anonymised location.

key_fields.field: Plz / Ort / Gemeinde / Gemeindeschluessel / Landkreis / Bundesland / StandortAnonymisiert
key_fields.meaning: Administrative location; for small units only 'PLZ Ort' in StandortAnonymisiert.
Operator (ABR… number); natural persons (PersonenArt 518) appear as 'natürliche Person (ABR…)'.
Technical generation location (SEL…): all units behind the same grid connection point(s); use it to group units into sites and detect co-located PV/wind.
Linked storage object (SSE…) and other grouping objects: EEG… (EEG-Anlage), SGE… (permit).
Grid voltage level of the connection (Niederspannung = household connection) and full vs partial feed-in (self-consumption).
Flags set when the location is reduced to PLZ and place; the second appears on some large organisation-owned units without coordinates.

steps: Filter on Energieträger 2496 (Speicher) AND Speichertechnologie 524 (Batterie) AND Betriebs-Status 35 (In Betrieb); filter syntax is field~operator~'value' joined with ~and~ (operators eq, gt, lt, nnn = not null, nnull = null, dnull = date null), URL-encoded.
Page with page= and pageSize=; the server accepted pageSize=600 in the test (UI offers 5/10/20). 'Total' gives the denominator for the filter.
Add a size filter for grid-scale lists, e.g. Bruttoleistung der Einheit~gt~'1000' (kW) or Nutzbare Speicherkapazität in kWh~gt~'1000'; there is no official 'grid-scale' flag.

Home vs grid-scale has no official flag: use BNetzA's 'Großbatteriespeicher' convention (Bruttoleistung > 999 kW), Battery Charts classes (home <30 kWh and <30 kW; large ≥1000 kWh or ≥1000 kW) or Spannungsebene (Niederspannung = household connection). State the rule used.
Convert JSON dates /Date(ms)/ to UTC dates; kW/1000 = MW, kWh/1000 = MWh.
Group units into sites by LokationMastrNr (same grid connection), then sum kW and kWh; query 'MaStR-Nr. der Lokation~eq~'SEL…'' without the storage filter to see co-located PV/wind units.

Classify hybrid vs stand-alone: a battery whose SEL also holds solar/wind units, or with a GemeinsamRegistrierteSolareinheitMastrNummer or an EEG-Anlage link, is co-located/RE-charged; a SEL holding only storage units is stand-alone.
For >25,000 rows use this JSON service with paging or the bulk Gesamtdatenexport: the page's CSV export only contains the first 25,000 records of a selection.
reading_traps: Denominators (test 2026-11-26): 2,979,782 battery units registered; 2,929,627 In Betrieb; 31,619 In Planung; 1,342 vorübergehend and 17,194 endgültig stillgelegt. 2,925,580 operating units (99.86%) are connected at Niederspannung, i.e. mostly household systems.

Grid-scale denominators on 2026-11-26 (In Betrieb): 556 units >1000 kW (4,750.9 MW gross, 4,625.3 MW net, 8,373.0 MWh) on 533 SEL; 803 units >1000 kWh; 8,458 units >30 kW; 3,101 units at Mittelspannung or above.

One installation can be many SEE: SWM Uppenborn (SEL954974074669) is 10 units of 2,610 kW, BMW Leipzig 4 'Partition' units; filtering units >1 MW misses sites built from sub-1 MW units. Count sites by LokationMastrNr, not rows.
A SEL can hold hundreds of other units: Batteriespeicher Cremzow (22 MW) shares SEL946360652124 with 221 units, mostly wind turbines. Sum only storage rows for storage capacity.

Inbetriebnahmedatum is the first technical commissioning (EEG-type definition for EE-storage), not the registration date; 184 of 556 operating units >1 MW were registered more than 31 days after commissioning, 15 before it.

Coordinates exist for 6,646 of 2,929,627 operating battery units: none at ≤30 kW; 1,812 units >30 kW also lack them, including large organisation-owned units flagged IsAnonymisiertNettoleistungZuHoch (e.g. RWE Werne 72 MW, LEAG 'Big Battery Lausitz' 66 MW) that only show 'PLZ Ort'.
Operator names are masked for natural persons: 2,851,374 of 2,929,627 operating battery units, 3,046 of 8,458 units >30 kW and 19 of 556 units >1 MW show 'natürliche Person (ABR…)'.
Bruttoleistung can exceed Nettonennleistung (RWE Hamm 174,240 vs 140,000 kW); say which one is used. The power is the discharge (Ausspeicher) power; charging power is not published for batteries.
Spannungsebene can hold several values: per-level counts summed to 2,929,870, i.e. 243 more than the operating total.
Data are self-declared by operators; NetzbetreiberpruefungStatus shows whether the grid operator has checked the entry.

Stand-alone vs co-located: in a random sample of 30 of the 533 SEL hosting units >1 MW, 24 held only storage, 4 also PV, 1 natural gas, 1 biomass+PV. An EEG-Anlage link (234 of 556) means RE-only charging, not necessarily a shared SEL (e.g. 'BESS Löwenberger Land II' is alone in its SEL).

Published aggregates differ by definition and date: BNetzA (Stand 15.10.2025, >999 kW) ca. 2.4 GW gross / 3.2 GWh; SMARD (20.08.2026) 1,292 facilities at or above medium voltage, ~3.6 GW net / ~6 GWh.
MaStR and operator documents can disagree: RWE Werne is 72,000 kW / 72,000 kWh in MaStR but 79 MWh in RWE's 2023 press release.

problems: The page's CSV table export is capped: 'Der Tabellen-Export enthält nur die ersten 25.000 Datensätze Ihrer Auswahl.'
Operator identity withheld for natural persons; location reduced to PLZ/Ort for units ≤30 kW and for some large units flagged as anonymised.
The JSON service is the viewer's internal grid endpoint; it is not documented as an API (the documented interfaces are the XML download and a registered SOAP Webdienst).

evidence.claim: Storage data structure: unit (SEE) holds discharge-side data, storage object (SSE) the usable capacity in kWh, SEL groups units at a common grid connection.
evidence.quote: Im Datenbankobjekt der zum Batteriespeicher gehörenden SEE werden die erzeugungsseitigen Daten eingetragen (z.B.: Ausspeicherleistung = Stromerzeugungsleistung).

evidence.claim: Technical location groups all units on a shared grid connection point.
evidence.quote: Die SEL umfasst alle SEE, die über einen oder mehrere gemeinsame Netzanschlusspunkte an das Stromnetz angeschlossen sind.

evidence.claim: Commissioning date of a battery is entered on the storage unit and on its EEG-Anlage.
evidence.quote: Sowohl bei der Speicher-Einheit als auch bei der EEG-Anlage des Speichers ist das Inbetriebnahmedatum des Batteriespeichers einzutragen.
Daten zu Marktakteuren nach der Anlage Tabelle A werden nicht veröffentlicht, wenn der Marktakteur eine natürliche Person ist; Daten sonstiger Marktakteure werden veröffentlicht.

evidence.claim: The viewer offers usable capacity as a column.
CSV export is limited to 25,000 rows per selection.
evidence.quote: Der Tabellen-Export enthält nur die ersten 25.000 Datensätze Ihrer Auswahl.
Unter dem Begriff „Großbatteriespeicher“ bzw. „Batteriegroßspeicher“ werden üblicherweise Stromspeicher mit einer Bruttoleistung größer 999 kW zusammengefasst.

Parse EinheitenStromSpeicher_1..30.xml (UTF-16) streaming; keep Technologie=524 and EinheitBetriebsstatus=35.

In AnlagenStromSpeicher_30.xml none of 80,383 storage objects links to more than one unit: a multi-container site is several SEE+SSE pairs, grouped only by SEL.
The format changed on 2025-10-01 ('neue Fassung'); scripts written for older exports may break.
Files are UTF-16 and the full archive expands to about 68 GB; stream-parse rather than load.
A third-party CSV conversion (open-MaStR on Zenodo) exists, but its latest release is the 2025-02-09 snapshot; use the BNetzA file for current data.
